description.en: A square white card with a soft shadow over a pastel wash, underlined fields and a compact square button on the right, in the spirit of Fluent Design. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.
Buttons, links, the selected tab and focused fields.

theme.json.formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 0 0% 95%;
  --foreground: 0 0% 11%;
  --card: 0 0% 100%;
  --card-foreground: 0 0% 11%;
  --muted: 0 0% 95%;
  --muted-foreground: 0 0% 38%;
  --accent: 0 0% 93%;
  --accent-foreground: 0 0% 11%;
  --border: 0 0% 82%;
  --input: 0 0% 40%;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web (West European)', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
}
.login-background {
  background: radial-gradient(900px 640px at 0% 0%, #d6e6f7 0%, transparent 62%), radial-gradient(820px 620px at 100% 100%, #f2dff0 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(700px 520px at 100% 0%, #dcf1ec 0%, transparent 58%), #f2f2f2;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 440px;
}
.login-panel {
  padding: 44px 44px 12px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}
.login-logo-box {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.login-logo-box img {
  max-height: 36px;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.signin-methods [role='tablist'] {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 24px;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  flex: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  color: #616161;
  font-size: 15px !important;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  color: #1b1b1b;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 {{accentColor}} !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #1b1b1b;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 36px;
  padding: 6px 0;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #666666;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 15px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-bottom: 2px solid {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: #1b1b1b;
  border-radius: 0;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-weight: 400;
}
.login-form a:hover {
  color: #666666;
}
.login-button-box {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  width: auto;
  min-width: 108px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 400;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 100px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link {
  justify-content: flex-start;
}
#footer {
  color: #616161;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
